build_gpt2_language_model: build a GPT-2 language model with a linear head for next-token prediction
create_gpt2_config: create a GPT2Config object with vocabulary size, layers, heads, and embedding dimensions
test_gpt2_model_forward: test the GPT2Model forward pass to get hidden states and attention outputs
run_gpt2_lm_head_inference: run GPT2LMHeadModel inference with optional labels to compute language modeling loss
review_gpt2_double_heads_model: review GPT2DoubleHeadsModel for language modeling and multiple-choice classification tasks
